plan.question: Can a conservative learned correction recover complementary S83 errors without discarding its strong image predictions?
plan.clinical_features: TRAIN-fold standardized age; TRAIN-vocabulary one-hot sex/site; missing/unseen neutral; no diagnosis type or identifiers
plan.reranker_rule: Binary residual over fixed log(P_runner/P_leader), only when margin<=0.5 and member argmax disagreement; keep pair mass and all noneligible outputs
plan.reranker_features: leader/runner one-hot classes plus six member runner-minus-leader probabilities
plan.penalty: Mean unweighted cross-entropy +0.01/2*squared correction parameters; identical fixed L2 for every fit
plan.optimizer: Zero initialization; L-BFGS-B, analytic gradients, maxiter500, ftol1e-12, gtol1e-7
plan.primary: All 1,503 original validation images, one held-out-meta prediction per image; no exclusion or altered denominator
plan.selection: Only passing candidates; accuracy then macro-F1, simpler image-only reranker on exact ties
plan.test_action: No candidate old-test scoring in this screen. A passing fixed deployment head requires a separate transparent retrospective assessment.
plan.limitation: Base CNNs/checkpoints and methodology were selected on this repeatedly used validation cohort; grouped crossfit protects only the new head fitting
plan.prior: Previous unrestricted stacking, feature fusion, scalar calibration and naive-Bayes metadata adjustments were unhelpful; these anchored residuals are distinct unproven hypotheses
